_comment: Echelon / oblique order form-up (#379): three player Spearmen units start bunched together west of the deploy line, get box-selected, then a vertical (north-to-south) right-drag deploys them with the new ECHELON_RIGHT distribution mode (form_up_dist=5, a live SelectionManager override -- see DemoInputRecorder.gd's _form_up_dist field) instead of one straight rank. A vertical drag (a above b, same x) puts the perpendicular deploy facing due east -- the same direction the units are already west of, so they march straight ahead instead of sideways. Because the drag runs top (a, left flank) to bottom (b, right flank), ECHELON_RIGHT staggers the bottom (southernmost) unit furthest east (leading) and the top (northernmost) unit furthest west (trailing) -- a diagonal line refusing the northern flank while the southern flank presses forward, the oblique-order concentration Caesar and Frederick the Great both used. drill:true (no team 1 at all) since this is a pure maneuver demo with nothing to fight. Camera holds one static wide frame covering both the starting cluster and the deployed diagonal, since the march is short enough not to need a pan.

path_crossing.reason: Soldier paths intersect transiently during the 90-man frontage and facing reorganization before marching into echelon.

misslotted.reason: Judged on full state dumps every 2 ticks, each block's form-up reads as misslotted while its men are still walking to their new places in the reform hold: worst 0.27, 0.28 and 0.28 for uids 0 to 2 on every seed against the 0.25 threshold (0.22, 0.27 and 0.30 on main, where uid 2 already fails), and all three pass at the script's own sampled ticks on both trees. Traced on seed 0, uid 0: from tick 330 the block's men stand a mean 2.24 wu from their nearest slot, just inside the settled test (a quarter of the 9 wu spacing), while 29 of 90 still stand nearer another man's slot; the count falls each sample to 3 by tick 500 and 0 by tick 600, when the block marches. The men are in transit, not settled on the wrong slots. With the same-unit standoff keeping men apart in the hold (overlap now passes for all three, 2.90 to 2.96 wu, against 1.15 to 1.58 on main), the blocks cross the settled test a few ticks earlier, while more men are still walking. misslotted having no transit window after a re-slot is #1892. Measured 2026-11-05 against main f57ccdfa, every exemption removed, seeds 0 to 4.
